title: 第250章 红纸人功法污染参与历史改变历史第249章 李家家风淳朴为人善良心绝不会那么脏
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 不得不说。
李守律发过来的这份情报。
真的是太细了。
密密麻麻。
条理清晰。
这几乎将天道宗最近三个月来的情况都发了过来。
即便李长生活了几百上千年，也忍不住给李守律点了一个赞。
“守律这孩子……”
“确实是个做卧底的料。”
李长生喃喃一声之后，就直接过滤了无关紧要的杂乱信息，将注意力集中在了情报核心上。
第一件事。
【父亲亲启：】
【守律于天道宗核心议事殿内探得绝密。】
【天道宗天机阁十位大乘期太上长老，于上月耗费万年寿元，联手推演天机。】
【现已彻底确认，即将降临的千年大劫，其真正的劫数根源，与虚空深处的镇龙殿全面复苏直接相关。】
【且这一次的劫数烈度远超修仙界以往任何一次纪元更迭。】
【一旦虚空与现实彻底重叠，其产生的法则风暴与血祭范围，足以在顷刻间掀翻大半个修仙界。】
【届时。】
【亿万生灵，皆为草芥。】
【大半个修仙界都将化为一片死域。】
李长生看到这里，心里冷笑一声。
果然跟我猜得一模一样。
镇龙殿这帮家伙。
想要把修仙界当成血包来吸啊。
李长生神识继续往下探去。
【为了在这一场前所未有的浩劫中扛过去，并且保全宗门道统，天道宗高层在密会中，定下了两步棋：】
【第一步：对大秦仙朝与大楚神国爆发的国战，采取作壁上观态度，口头上呼吁修仙界和平。】
【但暗地里却在同时扶持双方。】
【他们通过数个隐秘的白手套商会，源源不断地向大秦仙朝和大楚神国输送军需物资、疗伤圣药、甚至是上古攻伐阵盘。】
【其真正的目的，就是为了让大秦和大楚在战场上死磕，让他们拼命战斗，相互放血，消耗仙秦与神楚的底蕴。】
看到这李长生的嘴角忍不住抽搐了一下。
好家伙。
两头下注。
两头扶持。
拼命让别人打生打死。
自己坐收渔翁之利。
这特么的……
这风格。
怎么听起来这么耳熟呢？
这不就是老子平时最喜欢干的事情吗？
天道宗，作为堂堂修仙界第一正道魁首，满嘴的仁义道德。
背地里干起这种老六的事情来。
比老子还要丝滑？
呸。
content_en:
I have to say.
This information was sent by Li Shoulu.
It's really too thin.
Densely packed.
Clear and organized.
This almost summed up the situation of Tiandao Sect in the past three months.
Even though Li Chang had lived for hundreds or thousands of years, he couldn't help but give Li Shoulu a thumbs up.
"Shoulu, this kid..."
"He is indeed an undercover agent."
After Li Changsheng murmured, he directly filtered out the irrelevant and messy information and focused on the core of the intelligence.
…
First thing.
【Father's personal message:】
[Shou Lu discovered the top secret in the core meeting hall of Tiandao Sect. 】
[The ten Mahayana elders of the Tianji Pavilion of Tiandaozong spent ten thousand years of their lifespan last month to jointly deduce the secrets of heaven. 】
[It has now been completely confirmed that the real source of the upcoming thousand-year catastrophe is directly related to the full recovery of the Dragon Suppression Palace in the depths of the void. 】
[And the intensity of this calamity far exceeds any previous epoch change in the world of immortality. 】
[Once the void and reality completely overlap, the resulting legal storm and blood sacrifice range are enough to overturn most of the world of immortality in an instant. 】
【At that time. 】
[Billions of living beings are all nothing but grass and mustard. 】
[Most of the world of cultivating immortals will be turned into a dead zone. 】
When Li Changsheng saw this, he sneered in his heart.
Sure enough, it was exactly as I guessed.
These guys from Zhenlong Palace.
I want to suck the world of immortality as a blood bag.
Li Changsheng's consciousness continued to explore downwards.
[In order to survive this unprecedented catastrophe and preserve the sect’s orthodoxy, the senior officials of Tiandao Sect made two moves in a secret meeting:]
[The first step: Take a silent attitude towards the national war that broke out between the Great Qin Immortal Dynasty and the Great Chu Divine Kingdom, and verbally appeal for peace in the world of immortality. 】
[But secretly, they are supporting both parties at the same time. 】
[Through several secretive white glove chambers of commerce, they continuously transported military supplies, healing holy medicines, and even ancient attack arrays to the Great Qin Immortal Dynasty and the Great Chu Divine Kingdom. 】
[The real purpose is to make Da Qin and Da Chu fight each other on the battlefield, let them fight desperately, bleed each other, and consume the foundation of Xian Qin and Shen Chu. 】
Seeing this, the corners of Li Changsheng's mouth couldn't help but twitch.
Good guy.
Hedging your bets.
Support from both ends.
Try your best to beat others to life and death.
Take advantage of it yourself.
What the hell...
This style.
Why does it sound so familiar?
Isn't this what I usually like to do the most?
Tiandao Sect, as the most righteous leader in the world of immortality, is full of benevolence, righteousness and morality.
Doing this kind of shit behind your back.
Silkier than me?
Pooh.
title_en: Chapter 250: Red Paper Man’s exercise contaminates and participates in history to change history Chapter 249: The Li family’s simple family style and kind heart will never be so dirty
